_README: The asset vocabulary Sprint 3's item bank will be built against.
EDIT THIS FILE, not the script. It is the contract: normalise_item_images.py
renames files to match these keys, and the manifest reports present vs
expected against them. Nothing in the item bank should hardcode a filename
until the manifest reports zero gaps and zero unmapped files.
The object list was seeded from the 20 images supplied, with one spelling
corrected (cocnut -> coconut). If a key here is wrong, fix it here and
re-run; do not rename a file by hand.
Faces are a grid: every person x every emotion. 2 x 6 = 12.
DECLARED corrections, not guesses. A source filename token listed here is
mapped to its canonical key and reported as a correction in the run log.
Anything not resolvable directly or through this table is printed as
UNMAPPED and left alone -- the script never infers a key from context,
even when only one slot is empty.
